title: hieracium amplexicaule subsp. garidelianum
intro: Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. garidelianum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions, including digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The plant is reported to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium amplexicaule subsp. garidelianum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties.
